texts.preamble: Sharif Ibrahim Memon vs State Of Maharashtra on 24 November, 2025 Author: Madhav J. Jamdar Bench: Madhav J. Jamdar 2025:Bhc-As:51047 603-Aba-2471-202 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Anticipatory Bail Application No.2471 Of 2023 Shariff Ibrahim Memon & Anr. ... Applican Versus The State of Maharashtra ... Responde Mr. Tushar Sonawane, for the Applicants. Ms. R.V. Newton, App, for the Respondent-State. Mr. Bhushan Sanju Chavan, Killa Police Station, Malegaon, present. Coram: Madhav J. Jamdar, J. Dated : 24th November 2025
texts.facts: As per the prosecution case the Applicants were found dealing with contraband material which is unsafe and dangerous for the health of people. 4. It is the submission of Mr. Sonawane, learned Counsel that except the offence under Section 328 of IPC, all other offences are bailable offences.
texts.arguments: He submits that as far as Section 328 of IPC is concerned, the Supreme Court is considering the applicability of Section 328 of IPC to the similar cases. He therefore, states that the Anticipatory Bail be granted. 5. On the other hand, Ms. Newton, learned APP strongly opposes the Anticipatory Bail Application. She submits that the offence is very serious and therefore, the Anticipatory Bail Application be rejected. Learned APP submits that there is one antecedent being C.R. No.260 of 2015 for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and 26(2)(i), 3(i)(zz)(v), 26(2) (iv), 27(3)(d) and under Section 27(3)(e) of the Food Safety and Sharif Ibrahim Memon vs State Of Maharashtra on 24 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52354933/ 2 Standard Act, 2006. Learned APP submits that if this Court is inclined to grant Anticipatory Bail then the Applicants be directed to give undertaking in terms of order of the Supreme Court in the case of Abhijit Jitendra Lolage vs State of Maharashtra 1 and more particularly relies on following condition imposed by the Supreme Court in case of similar offences :- "It is deemed appropriate to impose the condition - "I, Abhijeet Jitendra Lolage do undertake to not deal with Gutkha, that is, Pan Masala with Tobacco". In case, the appellant - Abhijeet Jitendra Lolage violates the terms and conditions of bail, including the undertaking imposed, it would be open to the prosecution to seek cancellation of bail ". 7.
